1億円プレーヤーが62人いるのに、年俸の上限は8億円？ — The Price of Talent

Why do 62 players earn at least ¥100 million when a team has an ¥800 million cap? 集計単位の落とし穴から、労働市場、Bリーグの歴史、報酬上限制、契約の期限、給与公開の経済学までを探る。The surprising question is not just how much athletes earn, but who can see a price and when they can renegotiate it.
